answers: lens-red-team-code finding 1: done — The vacuous `stage.skip` count=0 assertions at DSFRSH-1 (lines ~844–855) and DSFRSH-2 (lines ~983–988) were replaced in Round 48 with non-vacuous `cycle.start > 0` assertions. The replacement is confirmed on disk: `grep -n "stage\.skip"` returns only a comment (line 966, the SPEC text); the actual assertions are `assert_gt` on `cycle.start` count. These CAN fail: if the dispatch-unit skip guard fires unconditionally, it skips intake → pipeline cannot proceed to dispatch `cyc` → `cycle.start` absent → count=0 → `assert_gt 0 > 0` → FAILS. After the code change (guard keyed on `resume_mode`), intake dispatches → `cyc` dispatched → PASSES.
